paragraphs: I started in 2013 as a freelance graphic and web designer, then spent years inside agencies learning how brands get attention.
In 2023 I went all in on AI, and on explaining it in the language most of our market actually speaks: Darija.
Today I build Algeria Business Bay with Larbi, work with AI labs on their MENA launches, and speak about what AI really changes for Algerian companies.

privacy.meta_description: How ketami.net handles your personal data: newsletter, contact form and analytics.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.p: ketami.net is run by Riyad Ketami (KETAMI), based in Algeria. For any question about your data, write to riyad@ketami.net.

For the newsletter: your email address, the language you chose, the date, IP address and browser of your signup and confirmation (proof of your consent), the page you signed up from, and whether you clicked links in my emails. For the contact form: the details you type in. For site statistics: anonymous usage data from Microsoft Clarity.
To send you the newsletter you asked for, based on your consent; to answer your messages; to see which content helps readers and to stop emailing people who no longer read.
Resend (email delivery, United States), MongoDB Atlas (database), Vercel (hosting), Upstash (anti-abuse rate limits) and Microsoft Clarity (statistics). Your data is never sold or rented.

Newsletter data is kept while you are subscribed. Unconfirmed signups are deleted after 14 days. Click and open records are deleted after 90 days. After you unsubscribe, I keep only your email and the date, so I never email you again by mistake.

You can access, correct or delete your data and withdraw your consent at any time: use the unsubscribe or settings link in any email, or write to riyad@ketami.net. I answer within one month. These rights come from Algerian Law 18-07 on personal data and, for readers in the European Union, from the GDPR.
